## Description

SERVICE_CATALOGUE (name, category, clinic code, SAC (IN), tax treatment Exempt or Taxable with a GST rate, duration, consultation kind) with immutable PRICE_VERSION (amount, currency, effective_from, doctor or clinic default). The catalogue is the only store of prices: a doctor's new-visit and follow-up fees are that doctor's prices for the two consultation services, written by Settings, Doctors and onboarding through a Billing contract, and Tenancy's old fee columns are copied once and no longer used. Billing settings: invoice, receipt and credit note prefixes (country numbering rules), payment methods, discount reasons, the largest discount without the Config capability, payment link expiry. Editor with invoice line preview and a price per doctor list; saving creates a new price version effective from a date in the facility time zone; archive instead of delete. Note "Tax treatment must be confirmed with your tax advisor". Everything behind the billing.invoices flag (release stage Internal while billing is built), except the doctor fees, which exist before billing is switched on. Payer price lists and UAE CPT/VAT move to the UAE launch (MDV-P4-008); packages to MDV-P4-010.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Saving a price creates a new version; versions are never changed or deleted (database rights); an issued invoice keeps the price version it was issued with (MDV-P4-004 test).
- [ ] **AC2.** A doctor's own price beats the clinic default; a future-dated version is not used before its day.
- [ ] **AC3.** India services carry SAC and GST exemption or rate (0-28 %).
- [ ] **AC4.** Doctor fees on Settings, Doctors and in onboarding are catalogue prices, saved in the same transaction as the doctor; existing fees are copied into the catalogue once.
- [ ] **AC5.** Billing settings validate prefixes by the country's numbering rules, a payment link expiry of 15-1440 minutes and at least one payment method.
- [ ] **AC6.** Changes are audited; only practice configuration can edit; the front desk (Invoices and payments) can read the catalogue; tenant isolation by EF filter and row-level security.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
